DICESONICE.configHint: This is where each player can configure their own individual 3D dice settings (enable/disable, colors, size, performances…)
DICESONICE.enable: Enable 3D Dice (This does not affect other players)
DICESONICE.ResetActorConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset this actor's dice appearance to the default?
DICESONICE.ImportLibrarySuccess: Dice Library imported successfully! {count} dice imported, {skipped} skipped (duplicate IDs).
DICESONICE.colorsetDesc: If you prefer a custom color, select 'Custom' in this list
DICESONICE.muteSoundSecretRolls: Mute all sounds for GM/Blind/Self rolls
DICESONICE.enableFlavorColorset: Apply damage type themes to dice
DICESONICE.skipAnimationOnInactiveTab: Skip animations when tab is inactive
DICESONICE.enableFlavorColorsetHint: Automatically restyle dice based on the roll's damage type.
DICESONICE.DamageTypeConfigMenuHint: Map damage types (fire, acid, radiant…) to specific dice presets or themes. Applied world-wide. GM only.
DICESONICE.DamageTypeConfigHint: Assign a dice preset or a theme to each damage type. Rows left empty inherit the default (a built-in theme with the same name, if any). Add custom entries for damage types your system uses.
DICESONICE.DamageTypeMissingId: A custom damage type is missing its id. Set the id before saving.
DICESONICE.DamageTypeSaveBroken: This save no longer exists. Select a new one or clear it.
DICESONICE.immersiveDarkness: Enable Immersive Darkness mode (Dice react to scene lighting)
DICESONICE.maxDiceNumberHint: Maximum number of displayed dice in an animation, applied independently to rolled dice and to persistent tabletop dice. Higher numbers will reduce performances
DICESONICE.persistentDiceCapReached: Dice So Nice: persistent dice limit reached. Remove some persistent dice before spawning more.
DICESONICE.migrateMessage: 'Dice So Nice' settings were successfully migrated to version {version}!
DICESONICE.migrateMessageNeedGM: 'Dice So Nice' needs to be migrated to v4. Please connect with a GM account.
DICESONICE.diceCanBeFlippedHint: When a die has finished rolling, can it be flipped by newly added rolling dice (This does not change the result).
DICESONICE.globalAnimationSpeedHint: Set the animation speed for all players instead of using their own settings
DICESONICE.disabledDuringCombatHint: Disable 3D dice roll animations while a combat is active.
DICESONICE.disabledForInitiativeHint: Disable 3D dice roll when rolling initiative from the combat tracker.
DICESONICE.disabledForManualRollsHint: Skip 3D dice animations when every die in a roll was fulfilled interactively (e.g. Foundry's Manual Input mode or physical dice modules).
DICESONICE.forceCharacterOwnerAppearance: When a roll is made on behalf of a player-owned character (e.g. GM rolling for a player), use the character owner's dice appearance instead of the roll author's.
DICESONICE.enabledSimultaneousRollsHint: Combine simultaneous rolls from different actions in a single animation instead of waiting for each roll to end.
DICESONICE.enabledSimultaneousRollForMes: When a single message contains multiple rolls, play all simultaneously
DICESONICE.immediatelyDisplayChatMessage: When enabled, do not wait for the 3D roll to finish before showing the roll chat card, and do not hide initiative values in the combat tracker while the animation plays
DICESONICE.animateRollTableHint: Show a 3D dice when rolling on a Roll Table. Need 'Animate roll tables' to 'off' in the core settings and 'Display Formula to Chat' to 'off' in the Roll Table.
DICESONICE.hideNpcRollsHint: Don't show 3D dice for any roll coming from an NPC.
DICESONICE.animateInlineRollHint: When possible, show 3D dice when an inline roll is detected in the chat.
DICESONICE.allowInteractivityHint: Let players grab and throw 3D dice after they've been rolled on the table (this has no effect on the results)
DICESONICE.persistentDiceHint: Allow players to place interactive 3D dice on the tabletop that can be picked up, shaken, and thrown to generate roll results. Requires 'Allow interaction with rolled dice' to be enabled.
DICESONICE.protectPersistentHint: Prevent other players from grabbing or throwing your persistent dice. The GM can always grab them.
DICESONICE.sidebarTabPersistentDisabled: Persistent dice are disabled. A GM can enable them in the module settings.
DICESONICE.hideSidebarTab: Hide the Dice So Nice sidebar tab
DICESONICE.hideSidebarTabHint: Remove the Dice So Nice tab from the right sidebar for every user in this world. Requires a reload.
DICESONICE.persistentDiceToolboxNotReady: Dice So Nice is not ready yet.
DICESONICE.persistentDiceToolboxClearMin: Remove all your persistent dice from the scene?
DICESONICE.persistentDiceToolboxClearAll: Remove every persistent die from the scene, including those belonging to other players?
DICESONICE.persistentDiceHelpSelect: Ctrl+click to select dice, click again to deselect
DICESONICE.persistentDiceHelpDelete: Press Delete or Backspace to remove selected dice
DICESONICE.persistentDiceHelpDrag: Click and drag a die to reposition it on the tabletop
DICESONICE.persistentDiceHelpThrow: Shake or swirl grabbed dice to throw them
DICESONICE.keybindingDeleteSelectedHint: Remove the persistent dice you have currently selected. Non-GM users can only delete their own dice.
DICESONICE.keybindingDismissEphemeralHin: Instantly clear any non-persistent 3D dice currently on screen.
DICESONICE.hide3dDiceOnSecretRollsHint: Do not display 3D dice to other players on GM/Blind rolls unless it is a ghost dice
DICESONICE.showGhostDice: Show Ghost dice for hidden rolls
DICESONICE.showGhostDiceHint: When possible, show a dice without numbers to players when rolling a GM or Blind roll.
DICESONICE.ghostDiceForPlayerRollsOnly: For player rolls only (hide GM rolls)
DICESONICE.navAppearanceHint: (Click on a die to customize it)
DICESONICE.WelcomeMessage1: It seems like you're using 3D dice for the first time in this world.
DICESONICE.WelcomeMessage2: You can configure (or disable) your 3D dice by clicking this button:
DICESONICE.WelcomeMessage3: You can always change these settings later under 'Configure Settings > Module Settings > Dice So Nice!'
DICESONICE.WelcomeMessage4: You won't see this message again. Happy rolling!
DICESONICE.WelcomeMessageTour: To take a quick tour of Dice So Nice features, check your Tour Management window or click this button.
DICESONICE.BackupHint: You can save or load multiple dice settings. They'll be saved in your user settings in this world only. If you wish to use them in a different world, please use the Import/Export buttons instead.
DICESONICE.SaveAsHint: Save all your current settings (appearances, special effects, etc.). You can either overwrite an existing save or create a new one.
DICESONICE.SaveAsErrorName: Please enter a name for your save file
DICESONICE.SaveAsErrorAlreadyExist: A save file with this name already exist. Choose another name or use the Overwrite button to update your save.
DICESONICE.ImportHint: You can import a previously exported JSON file. This will overwrite your current settings but not your save files. This operation can't be undone.
DICESONICE.ImportNoFile: No file found. Please select a file to import.
DICESONICE.GMPushHint: Push your current dice configuration to every other player, including disconnected ones.
DICESONICE.GMPushDialogHint: Select which parts of your configuration to push. Each selected category will overwrite the matching data on every non-GM player.
DICESONICE.GMPushWarning: This overwrites the selected settings for all non-GM players, including disconnected ones. It cannot be undone.
DICESONICE.GMPushNone: Select at least one category to push.
DICESONICE.GMPushReceived: The GM has updated your Dice So Nice configuration.
DICESONICE.sfxOptionsIsGlobal: (GM Only) Enable this SFX for all players
DICESONICE.sfxModeToggle: Switch between basic and advanced mode
DICESONICE.sfxModeConfirmContent: Switching to basic mode will discard the current formula. Continue?
DICESONICE.sfxFormulaErrorCountBadDie: Invalid die term inside {kw}(). Use format: [count]d<faces>[modifier]
DICESONICE.sfxFormulaErrorBadKeyword: Unknown keyword "{kw}". Use: success, failure, discarded, rerolled, exploded, count
DICESONICE.sfxFormulaErrorBadStart: Formula must start with a die term (e.g., d20), "total", or a keyword (e.g., success(d6cs=3))
DICESONICE.sfxFormulaErrorBadModifier: Unsupported modifier "{mod}". Use: cs, cf, kh, kl, dl, dh
DICESONICE.sfxFormulaErrorTooManyParts: Too many parts. Use format: [count]d<faces>[modifier] [operator value]
DICESONICE.sfxFormulaErrorCountPredicate: Invalid count() formula. Expected: count(<count>d<faces>[modifier] <operator> <value>) <operator> <value>. Example: count(3d20 == 20) >= 2
DICESONICE.sfxHelpText: Use the toggle button to switch to advanced formula mode.
DICESONICE.RollableAreaConfigHint: Define the portion of the screen that shows the 3D dice animation. This setting won't affect other players.
DICESONICE.RollableAreaConfigDescription: Resize and/or move the area to define the "Rollable Area" within which 3D dice animation is shown.
While having a custom rollable area, resizing the window won't automatically resize the rollable area. You'll have to restore or resize the custom area yourself.
Press "Apply" to save and apply your changes or press "Restore" to return to the automatic settings.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentGotoDsnSidebar: Click on the Dice So Nice sidebar tab. This is your quick access to spawn dice, manage persistent dice, and open your settings.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentGotoModulesSet: Click on the Dice So Nice settings filter
DICESONICE.TourMainContentGotoConfigure: Click on the Configure Settings button
DICESONICE.TourMainContentGotoDiceSoNice: This is where the GM and users can configure settings for Dice So Nice! Anything outside of the 3D Dice Settings is affecting all players.
Open your personal 3D dice settings to customize your dice.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentShow3DDice: This is the 3D dice preview. You can see your own dice here. Each player has their own dice. You can also click on a die to customize it.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentShowAppearance: Below the preview, you can change your dice appearance. Browse the available themes or create your own.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentShowPreference: Change your preferences to your liking. Sounds, animation speed, dice scale and more.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentShowSFX: You can add special effects to your rolls. For example, you can add a sound effect when you roll a 20!
DICESONICE.TourMainContentShowPerformanc: Choose the dice ambiance and tweak rendering settings to match your hardware.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentShowBackup: This tab is where you manage your dice data: save and load multiple profiles, import/export to JSON, reset to defaults, and (as GM) push your config to your players.
DICESONICE.TourMainContentEndTour: If you want more info, check out our documentation website. Happy rolling!
DICESONICE.resetWelcomeMessageHint: This will reset the welcome message for all players. They'll see the welcome message again the next time they join this world.
DICESONICE.ChatCommandDescription: Roll 3D dice without creating a chat message
DICESONICE.editorPreviewHint: Right-drag to orbit. Click a face to select it. Ctrl+click to select multiple.
DICESONICE.editorClickFace: Click a face on the die to customize it
DICESONICE.editorDeleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?
DICESONICE.editorNoCustomDice: No custom dice yet. Click "Create New" to get started!
DICESONICE.editorCustomTextureSizeWarn: Image exceeds 1024px. Large textures may impact performance.
DICESONICE.libraryNoDice: No custom dice in this section.
DICESONICE.glyphPicker.title: Pick a glyph
DICESONICE.glyphPicker.nativeHint: Tip: you can also paste any emoji from your OS picker - <kbd>Win</kbd>+<kbd>.</kbd> on Windows, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd> on macOS, <kbd>Super</kbd>+<kbd>.</kbd> on Linux.

DICESONICE.CustomDiceTermDefaultAppearan: Select a die from your library to use as the default appearance for all players. Players can override this in their own settings.
